summary: Drafted a 3-step plan for adding GET /healthz endpoint to the flywheel-tui server. The plan mirrors the existing /hello pattern: add route in src/server/index.ts, add tests in tests/server.test.ts, then run the full test suite. Plan file written to .flywheel/plans/feat-healthz-endpoint.plan.json. Three behavioral contracts cover: 200 response with status+uptime, 405 for non-GET methods.
